entry.title: New: Resolution 562 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR (Draft 2) AGREEMENT WITH HAWAIʻI ISLAND EV, LLC, TO REPLACE HAWAIʻI COUNTY SHARED-USE ELECTRIC VEHICLES

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a ten-year lease agreement with an approximate monthly cost of $8,357, to replace the County’s disposed shared-use electric vehicle fleet with eight new electric vehicles.
